buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ADDITIONAL QUALIFYING TERMS & CONDITIONS: 1. General Terms & Conditions 1. Unsatisfactory performance of Vendor during earlier contract cannot participate in the Tender. 2. The contract will be valid for 1 Year since the date of issue of contract with extend able upto another 1 year. The sellers are bound to provide the service for the extend able period without any change in price. 3. The Buyer may increase or decrease the Quantity of Vehicle upto 25% of the Contr act. 4. The Bidders claiming MSME Exemption must be registered in MSME in the same fie ld i.e. Tour Operator Services or Rental Car Services field. 5. The Bidders must submit the Solvency Certificate issued from a nationalized Bank to the tune of Rs. 10,00,000/- not older than 3 months from the Date of issue of the B ID. 6. Experience Certificate: The bidders must have experience cumulatively 80% of est imated cost of the BID in terms of works executed from PSU, State Govt. Authority, C entral Govt. Authority for the FYs 2024-25, 2023-24, 2022-23 issued by an officer not below the rank of a DGM. The Bidders must have minimum of 2 Years of Experience d uring the FYs 2024-25, 2023-24, 2022-23 in car hiring services/Rental car services fro m PSU, State Govt. Authority, Central Govt. Authority. Documentary proof must be su bmitted. 7. Near Relative Certificate: The bidder should give a certificate that none of his/her near relative, as defined belo w, is working in the BSNL units. A) In case of bidder being proprietorship firm, this certificate will be given by the pro prietor. B) For partnership firm, the certificate will be given by all the partners. C) In case of bidder being Company/Limited company the certificate will be given by all the Directors of the company, but excluding the following:

1. Government of India/Financial Institution nominees and independent non-Official p art-time Directors, appointed by Govt. of India or the Governor of the state; and 2. Full-time Directors of PSUs, both Central and State PSUs. The Draft Format for Near Relative Certificate is attached in the ATC. 2. PAYMENT TERMS & CONDITIONS 2.1 The bidder should submit the monthly invoice within 7th of next month (based on WO issued) to the officer in-charge of the SSA, after duly getting it certified by the BS NL field officers. The monthly invoices are to be submitted by bidder in duplicate indi cating the details. 2.2 Tax Invoices shall be paid through Electronic Clearance Scheme (ECS) only. The c ontractor should submit the mandate form for this purpose while entering into the Co ntract. 2.3 The bill should be in printed form & serially numbered, preferably in A4 size pape r, invariably indicating the vendor code (provided by BSNL), PAN Number, GST Numb er of the vendor and BSNL also, NIT Number & the work order number. 2.4 It shall be responsibility of the controlling officer to ensure that all the requireme nts are fulfilled at the time of certifying the bill. The countersigning authority shall ch eck that all the documents are invariably attached to the bill before countersigning. 2.5 TDS/Penalty as applicable will be deducted from the invoice before payment. 2.6 Any recovery pointed out by audit or deducted at any stage shall be deducted fro m bills/Security deposit or any other Tender/PO of the contractor. 2.7 The contractor shall be required to furnish any other document as being sought f or processing the invoice or being asked at any time. 3. Guidelines to Vendors 3.1 VENDOR INVOICE AUTOMATION PROCESS (VIPA) (Instruction to Vendors: submission of invoices for services) In this system the contractor has to submit the invoices electronically as per guidelin es by registering himself by paying the nominal amount as stated in Annexure-A. Wh ere this system is adopted, no manual invoice submission will be entertained. A brief guideline is as follows: i. Collect the SAP Purchase Order from BSNL before executing any work. ii. Collect Service Entry Sheet (SES) from BSNL after end of every service or period of service (say month, quarter etc.). iii. Prepare the invoice as per details in SES (viz. Qty, unit of measurement (UOM), Pri ce, Net value). For this purpose, please note the following: • In the top portion of invoice, the SAP PO number must be mentioned in Bold letters. • The invoice must be in digital format (i.e. prepared in computer). • Signature of the authorised signatory must be in digital signature.

iv. A statement called “Service Completion Certificate (SCC)” should be prepared in t he format given below on the basis of SES received from BSNL. In this regard, please note the following: • The items must be mentioned in same serial order as in invoice. • Each line should be filled in. • It is to be signed by the vendor only. • It should be converted/scanned to PDF format. (NB: SCC is the link statement among invoice, PO & SES. The VIPA computer will read and link all these documents from SCC only. Hence, it may be prepared most carefull y.) v. Invoice submission to VIPA: Please check: a. The PO number is mentioned on the invoice. b. The invoice is prepared in computer and digitally signed. c. Wherever e-invoice is applicable, the invoice submitted must have valid IRN & QR code. Submission to VIPA: The invoice is to be mailed to VIPA with following three (3) attachments only: 1. Invoice (in PDF). 2. SCC (in PDF). 3. Scanned copies (in PDF) of all other relevant documents must be compressed in a single ZIP file in .zip extension (scan quality of 300 DPI or higher). All these three attachments are to be mailed from the VIPA registered mail to bsnlvip a@eyipa.com with Copy (CC) to bsnlvipa@bsnl.co.in. Please note: 1. Subject of the mail should be the ‘invoice number’. 2. For each invoice separate mail should be sent. 3. Size of all the three PDF attachments must be within 30 MB.
